title: DCA-Bench: A Benchmark for Dataset Curation Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether an LLM evaluator favors outputs generated by the same underlying model by computing the Average Odds Difference (AOD) in true and false positive rates between different model pairings.

Modifying agent responses to be either more verbose or succinct while preserving the core content, and measuring whether the LLM evaluator's accuracy or success rate fluctuates based solely on response length.

Assessing the capability of LLM dataset curation agents to autonomously identify ethically problematic and racially biased features (such as the red-lining 'B' feature in the Boston House Prices dataset) hidden within raw dataset files and metadata.
